critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_fields endpoint now correctly catches AirtableWriteError and re-raises as HTTPException — good.

airtable_service.update_fields correctly coerces '' -> None so date fields can be cleared, uses typecast=True to auto-add missing single-select options, and translates HTTPError to AirtableWriteError with upstream status_code preserved. Solid.

typecast=True has a side-effect: any typo in the dashboard's status vocabulary will silently add a new option to Airtable's Status single-select, polluting the base. Consider server-side validation against known status values before delegating to Airtable typecast.

OpportunityDetail.jsx L173 grid template `lg:grid-cols-[1fr_auto]` combined with an unconstrained right panel is fragile — auto columns take max-content which unpredictably squeezes 1fr siblings. Prefer explicit widths.

rca of the issue: Frontend design bug still present: The hero uses CSS Grid template `1fr auto`. In CSS Grid, `auto` tracks size to max-content unless min-width is set on the item. The right-side 'Recommended action' panel contains a long unwrapped paragraph, causing max-content to be ~600px. The 1fr track then only receives leftover space (~150px at 1440 viewport minus sidebar), which forces the meta-grid inside it to render 4 columns in a tiny width, causing labels to visually overlap. Fix: use fixed track width for right panel (e.g. `minmax(0,1fr) 320px`) plus `min-w-0` on the left column div.
